name: Ticking Bomb
text: Each round, once you've trumped three times, gain +1× contract multiplier.

signature.trigger: you trump for the third time each round

family: Growth over the round / Outcome counters (trumps played)
role: Payoff (Contract multiplier, built during the round)
decision: Whether to open a second void and trump in over a partner's winner to reach the third trump, knowing the +1× then doubles a failed contract too, so the bid must be safe before the count lands.
opponent: The count is public through plays and the multiplier is shown when it lands; opponents can deny it by leading spades to pull trumps or by leading the suits the owner still holds.
aiNote: Count trumps played; once at three, trump rather than discard when void, and bid a little conservatively when the hand shows two voids.
rationale: A void-and-trump deck with Alchemist's Wand (DU-S02) trumps three times in about half its rounds, and those rounds are usually made, so the +1× is worth about +35 mid-run and +45 late, inside the rare band; it shares Second Strike's (RE-U04) counting phrase but pays a multiplier, not spade rank, and counts no throw-offs (GR-R05).
